original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚高原州潘克辛地方政府主席誓言打击疑似仪式杀人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚高原州潘克辛地方政府委员会主席费利克斯·戈农表示，将打击当地疑似仪式杀人行为。此前一个月内当地记录到两起死亡事件，据称死者重要器官被摘取。三名嫌疑人已被逮捕并移交至乔斯警察总部，安全机构正就另一起案件展开调查。

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: confirmed that vital organs were allegedly harvested from the victims

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: three suspects were arrested following the discovery of a woman’s body last month

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the discovery of a young man’s body at Monday Market on Oct. 6, with vital organs allegedly missing
